eps.ov: Manabe Hibiki suddenly finds himself in an isekai. After finally getting out of a maze, he meets Emalia.
When the Tutorial skill levels up, Hibiki loses his "Guide." But he slowly learns how to do things on his own.
Hibiki gains two companions, Claude and Lillian. And apparently the Tutorial skill is incredibly good.
Vene teaches Hibiki and Lillian the basics of magic. After ages, Hibiki manages to learn... a cleaning spell.

eps.t: That Looks Absurdly Good on You
eps.ov: Hibiki puts on girls clothes and looks really good in them. But he is doing that just to catch a thief!

eps.t: I Recommend Using Summon Sacred Beast
eps.ov: Ivell sends Hibiki's party deeper into the woods, and Hibiki gets mortally wounded. Can't anyone help?!

eps.t: Please Adhere to the Usage Instructions When Using It
eps.ov: Sapo-chan announces that Enlightened Mode of the Expert Eye is activated, but how can it help Claude?
It's so hot that everyone is suffering, especially Claude. Hibiki sets out to find a way to cool them down.

eps.t: Acquired Master of Walking Into Traps
eps.ov: Hibiki and party join Fauna in trying to vanquish an endless undead horde to save a village.

eps.t: I Cannot Answer That Kind of Question
eps.ov: The party made it to the northern dungeon. But right before they enter they're talking about... underpants?
Hibiki finds out that he can actually copy/paste rented skills and questions if that's not cheating.
Hibiki is all alone and has to face Ivell who is out for blood. She even reduces all his levels down to 1...
